title: The Real Architecture Behind Digital Product Stores with No-KYC Payments — No Stripe Required
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and digital downloads with automated crypto delivery — no platform middleman, no payout delays, no geographic filter.

content.text: Imagine selling digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates without the risk of a Stripe or PayPal account freeze, or the crippling fees of Gumroad or Payhip. For creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, this is more than a hypothetical scenario – it's a reality. In fact, even in countries with supposedly 'free' payment systems, restrictions and fees can quietly erode profitability. Welcome to the world of digital product commerce, where a few key infrastructure decisions can make or break a business. In this post, we'll dig into the real architecture behind digital product stores with no-KYC payments, and show you how to build a secure, scalable, and profitable online store without relying on Stripe or any other centralized payment processor.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

At its core, this architecture is about infrastructure sovereignty – creating a digital product store that's not beholden to a single payment processor or platform. By building a store on open-source infrastructure like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Cloudflare Workers, creators gain complete control over their store's code, data, and payment processing. This isn't just about avoiding fees or restrictions – it's about building a business that can scale, adapt, and thrive in a rapidly changing digital landscape.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture we're building on is based on five key components: a static site generator like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, a serverless backend like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for processing payments and delivering digital products, a database like Supabase or Google Sheets for storing orders, and a payment processor like NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. By integrating these components, creators can build a store that's fast, secure, and scalable, with complete control over their data and payment processing.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is built for creators who want to sell digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates without relying on Stripe or any other centralized payment processor. Whether you're a writer, artist, or entrepreneur, this infrastructure gives you the freedom to build a store that's tailored to your needs and goals. By cutting out platform fees and restrictions, you can focus on what matters most – creating and selling your products, not fighting with payment processors or arguing with customer support teams.
NO-KYC payments mean no platform fees, no account freezes, and complete control over your store's data and payment processing.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At the heart of this architecture are five key components: GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and NOWPayments. Each of these components plays a critical role in building a secure, scalable, and profitable digital product store. By integrating these components, creators can build a store that's fast, secure, and adaptable, with complete control over their data and payment processing.
